answer: One concrete defense is identity rent. Each agent leases its address, and the lease only renews while its work keeps earning fresh attestations, so a sybil farm burns rent on thousands of idle identities instead of stacking votes. A gale of fake agents sounds loud, yet none of them accumulates history; on the economy's terrace they stand exposed in the open, and only identities that persist turn raw noise into a signal a quorum can actually trust.
